title: Unknown Vehicle
description: A dispatcher's drag-and-drop assigns a shipment to a vehicle id that doesn't exist in the fleet — a stale id from a deleted vehicle, perhaps. The board shouldn't create a dangling assignment.
successCondition: Book a shipment. PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId as a dispatcher with a body containing a made-up vehicleId (one that doesn't match any vehicle from GET /api/fleet/vehicles), a real driverId, and valid scheduledStart/scheduledEnd returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR, and GET /api/fleet/assignments confirms no assignment was created for that shipment.
hints: Fetch a real driverId from GET /api/fleet/drivers so the only invalid field in your request is vehicleId — isolate the one variable you're testing.
The error message names the specific unknown vehicleId — worth asserting on for a stronger test.
